title: 多年失败产品后，他终于做到月入11万
title_en: After Years of Failed Products, He Finally Hit $110K/Month
title_jp: 長年の失敗製品の後、ついに月収11万ドル達成
title_ar: بعد سنوات من المنتجات الفاشلة، حقق أخيرا 110 ألف دولار شهريا

{"ops": [{"insert": "多年失败产品后，他终于做到月入11万"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "16岁做软件工程师，他说：每天工作16小时是我唯一的原因", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nic来自Ukraine。16岁开始做software engineer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually realized didn't really want grow in engineering role。Indie hacking seemed like so much more fun。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also seemed like much easier way earn money。Oh boy，was wrong。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年开始indie hacking，同时full-time job。Very few applicable skills。Shy introvert。No big ideas。Didn't know any founders。Just knew how to code，didn't want to stop。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Spent 1.5年figuring it out with failed product after failed product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then，launch了一个blog，grew到about $500月收入。While working on that blog，realized Pinterest是drive traffic to websites的好channel。Created tool automate process，became BlogToPin。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch三周后，quit job。No revenue，但about a year runway，decide give it a try。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Now ~15k MRR（约11万人民币），去年from $10k增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Recently also building email marketing tool for SaaS called Sequenzy。六个月前launch，现在1k MRR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "BlogToPin initial version用一两个月build。但truth是took a while before working well——very ambitious problem solve。Probably another six months improve和get users。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mostly designed by vibe coding和copy-pasting from Tailwind UI。技术栈：Next.js + Drizzle。还用separate Express.js server handle long-running tasks——pin creation、website processing、pin scheduling、pin uploading。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "NextJS", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Drizzle", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "tRPC", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "shadcn", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Express", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "BullMQ（for jobs）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MySQL on PlanetScale（for data）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It's simple，but AI good at it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sell monthly和annual subscriptions at $39、$79、$179。大部分人在cheapest plan。Approximately 30% choose annual。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Churn是目前最大issue。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 人们starting out时不consider，但churn limits ceiling。BlogToPin's churn ~10-15%，意味着need acquire extra $2k MRR each month just stay even。That's a lot。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch Sequenzy时，top priority是choosing infrastructure niche——因为inherently low churn。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Growth mostly because built good product。当然，spread the word everywhere can，stick with easiest channels。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO content：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Target "Pinterest marketing tool"，use that everywhere on website。Also create listicles和do outreach for backlinks。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Encouraging referrals：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Give generous 30% lifetime commission。Very good rate，lots of people happy with app，so promote it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "YouTube：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Focus on SEO-optimized keywords like "how to not get banned"、"how to create AI pins"等。Gets few views here and there，compounds over time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Replying on reddit：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Very slow、manual thing。Don't use tool，just try be genuinely helpful。But reddit getting harder and harder。Mods banning people all the time。Tricky。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Influencer marketing：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Reached out to all influencers in niche——two people replied。Only one brought lot of customers。Numbers game。But importantly，have to be super open-minded、adjust product、try make it genuinely useful for influencer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO probably contributes 50%，great because basically works on autopilot。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Made lot of dumb mistakes。Probably made every single mistake possible。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product is where is for only one reason："}, {"insert": "Work 16 hours per day。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It's that simple。Outwork every competitor。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Because work so much，can run more experiments、talk to more customers、ultimately make better product。That compounds。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Get ready for a long haul。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ship fast。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Iterate。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't quit。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "真的。Just don't stop。Whenever unsure what to do next，do something。Improve product、do marketing、talk to customers。Anything。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nic的故事告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Success doesn't require genius。It requires persistence and work ethic。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1.5年失败产品。然后breakthrough。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "His secret？"}, {"insert": "16 hours a day。Outworking competition。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这不是glamorous的建议。不是growth hacks或secret tactics。就是hard work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But he's also smart about it——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus on low-churn niches for new products", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "30% lifetime commission for referrals（generous）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO works on autopilot once set up", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Be genuinely helpful on Reddit（even if slow）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Goal：BlogToPin到$20-30k MRR，Sequenzy到$100k MRR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他会做到的。Because he doesn't quit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: After years of failed products finally achieved one hundred ten thousand monthly. Sixteen year old software engineer he says working sixteen hours daily is my only reason. Nic from Ukraine. Started as software engineer at age sixteen. Eventually realized did not really want grow in engineering role. Indie hacking seemed like so much more fun. Also seemed like much easier way earn money. Oh boy was wrong. Twenty twenty two started indie hacking while full-time job. Very few applicable skills. Shy introvert. No big ideas. Did not know any founders. Just knew how to code did not want to stop. Spent one and a half years figuring it out with failed product after failed product. Then launched.
